title: Add post-engine AC trunnion IK and G93 pass in camcraft-post

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Connect the shared Rust AC trunnion IK solver (`#1965`) and `G93` inverse-time feed solver (`#1966`) to `post::engine` (`crates/post/src/post/engine.rs`) for non-RTCP AC table-table machines.

### Context
- `crates/post/src/kinematics/` (`solve_path`, `solve_toolpath`) and `crates/post/src/post/g93.rs` (`solve_g93_solved_moves`) are tested in isolation, but `post::engine` does not call them yet.
- `crates/post/src/machine/trunnion.rs` supports per-axis `sign_convention` (`tool_rh` or `table_rh`) on `A` and `C`, while `AcTrunnionConfig` (`crates/post/src/kinematics/types.rs`) currently holds one machine-level `sign` field.
- Putting the non-RTCP AC IK and `G93` transform in `crates/post/src/post/` (following the manifest-gated pass pattern of `wcs_flip.rs`, `wcs_rotate.rs`, and `invert.rs`) keeps `machine::check_ops` (`#1969`) and `mach4.cps` on one shared solver.

### Requirements
- Add per-axis rotary sign convention support to `RotaryAxisConfig` and `AcTrunnionConfig` (keeping existing constructors and tests passing).
- Add a clean builder from `Machine` (and optional setup `PARAM` overrides for `a_pivot`, `wcs_offset`, and `work_datum`) to `AcTrunnionConfig` and `AxisSpeedLimits`, refusing incomplete trunnion geometry by name.
- Add a manifest-gated engine pass in `crates/post/src/post/` that runs on `PARAM SectionMode "simultaneous 5-axis"` sections when `controller.rtcp == false` and the post script declares support.
- Inside that pass, run `solve_path` and `solve_g93_solved_moves`, skip zero-motion duplicates, refuse unlinearized arcs by name, and deliver pre-compensated `X Y Z A C` coordinates and per-block `G93` `F` values to the script hooks.
- Leave 3-axis sections, `3+2 indexed` sections, and RTCP posts (`controller.rtcp != false` or scripts without the manifest flag) unchanged.

Done means: Non-RTCP `simultaneous 5-axis` sections run through the shared Rust IK and `G93` pass, deliver pre-compensated `X Y Z A C` and per-block `G93` `F` to opting-in post scripts, refuse unlinearized arcs or missing geometry by name, and leave 3-axis and RTCP posts unchanged.

Part of #1958
